description: Centralized model serving gateway for internally hosted and fine-tuned models on Databricks platform

justification.D_rationale: D=0: When serving internally trained/fine-tuned models, the organization has full control over training data, inference data, and the serving infrastructure within its Databricks workspace.
justification.T_rationale: T=0: For internally trained models, the organization has full visibility into model architecture, weights, training process, and hyperparameters through the MLflow model registry.
justification.A_rationale: A=0: The gateway serves model inference endpoints that respond only when explicitly invoked by application code. No autonomous behavior.

edge_case_notes: When Mosaic AI Gateway routes to external model APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), those specific routes should be classified as Tier B. The gateway itself is Tier A infrastructure.
